title: Contest a speeding or parking ticket with a written defense
summary: Give your bot a photo of the ticket and your side of the story. It works out how to contest it, writes the defense, and tracks the deadline.
what_the_bot_does: Reads the ticket and pulls out the violation, date, place, fine and the deadline to respond.
Finds the official way to contest it for that city or state (online, by mail or in person).
Asks you what actually happened and what proof you have, such as photos, receipts or signs.
Writes a short, factual written defense and a checklist of what to attach.
Shows you everything before anything is filed, then reminds you before the deadline.
what_you_end_up_with: A ready-to-submit written defense, the right place to file it, and a reminder before the deadline.

tools.note: The shared example used Grok Bot

prompt: Here's a photo of my [speeding/parking] ticket from [city, state]. What happened: [your honest account]. Proof I have: [photos, receipts, witnesses]. 1) Tell me the deadline to respond and the official way to contest it, with a link to the official page. 2) Write a short, factual written defense using only what I've told you. Don't invent facts. 3) List what I should attach. Don't submit anything or pay anything without asking me first.
watch_out: One person's win isn't a guarantee. The shared example is a single DC ticket, and rules and odds differ by city and state.
Only state facts that are true. You sign what gets submitted, not the bot.
Check the deadline on the ticket itself. Missing it can add late fees.
Blur or remove your personal details before sharing screenshots. The poster had the bot anonymize his.

sources.label: X post by @congressdj (2026-10-18): Grok Bot contested a Washington DC speeding ticket for him and won, with the ticket, prompt, defense and ruling shown
